name: Parallel C
meaning: Parallel workstreams form a recognizable initial.
subject: Three bold nested, open-right C-shaped paths, like three parallel lanes taking the same rounded bend. Their ends are deliberately staggered. The outer two paths are warm ivory and the shortest inner path is amber. One strong compact C silhouette, excellent negative space. Charcoal app tile.
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: a standalone macOS application icon concept for Codealong.
Product context: Codealong is a Mac utility that gathers all coding agents across tools and accounts into a live board organized by project, repository, worktree, branch and pull request. It shows who is working, who needs human attention, and opens each session in its original app. The identity should communicate calm awareness of parallel work.
Primary request: design ONE original, beautifully proportioned app icon for the concept below.
Style/medium: expert brand designer, crisp flat vector-like geometry, bold memorable silhouette, elegant optical spacing, restrained professional developer utility. Flat colors inside the symbol, no gradients or surface textures. This is a brand exploration, not a UI screenshot.
Composition/framing: square image, one large macOS rounded-square tile centered, about 82 percent of canvas width, straight-on, very subtle exterior shadow, warm light neutral #f2f3f1 surrounding canvas. Symbol centered on the tile and occupying roughly 58 percent of tile width. Consistent generous padding. No perspective.
Color palette: existing Codealong charcoal #15181a, warm ivory #e8ebe7, amber #f5a524; use only these for the icon. Outside backdrop #f2f3f1.
Constraints: one icon only; no lettering, no wordmark, no captions, no numbers, no grids, no mockup devices, no watermark, no robots, no faces, no generic AI sparkle. Keep shapes thick enough to read at 32 pixels.
Concept: Three bold nested, open-right C-shaped paths, like three parallel lanes taking the same rounded bend. Their ends are deliberately staggered. The outer two paths are warm ivory and the shortest inner path is amber. One strong compact C silhouette, excellent negative space. Charcoal app tile.

name: Beacon
meaning: A calm signal shows which agent needs you.
subject: A striking minimal beacon symbol: one solid amber circle near the upper center, above two broad nested ivory arch bands opening downward. The arches are like a calm signal reaching multiple agents, not a Wi-Fi icon: use a tall architectural doorway proportion, straight lower legs, and a substantial amber dot inside its upper opening. Charcoal app tile.
